description: This file is a shell script that defines a test suite for verifying the behavior of the 'git diff-tree' command, especially in scenarios involving duplicate entries in Git trees. It includes setup functions, test cases creating trees with duplicate entries, and several test executions to ensure proper handling of such cases.

methods.name: make_tree_entry
methods.description: Creates a tree entry with specified mode, type, and SHA1, then outputs it for git to process.

methods.name: make_tree
methods.description: Constructs a git tree object from multiple entries by repeatedly calling make_tree_entry.
